Class Rewards

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Rewards
public final class Rewards extends Object
Rewards beyond money, the same in every Tempest plugin (Core API version 18): items and a server command.

Admins type items as one line, Ingredient_Bar_Iron x16, Food_Bread x5 (16 Ingredient_Bar_Iron and a bare id for one work too). giveItems(UUID, String, String, Map, List) puts them in the player's inventory; what does not fit, and everything for a player who is offline, waits in their mailbox (/mail), so a reward is never dropped or lost. 

String problem = Rewards.itemsProblem(text);           // null when it can be saved (empty is fine)
Rewards.giveItems(uuid, "Dragons", "server.dragons.mail.reward", Map.of("dragon", "Ember"), Rewards.parseItems(text));
Rewards.runCommand(uuid, name, "cratekey give {player} vote 1");   // as the console, {player} and {uuid} filled in
Only a player with COMMAND_PERMISSION may write or change a command (it runs as the console). Any thread.

    • giveItems

      public static boolean giveItems(UUID player, String from, String titleKey, Map<String,String> params, List<Mailbox.Item> items)
      Gives the items: into the inventory of a player who is online, the rest (and everything for a player who is offline) into their mailbox, where it waits until they take it with /mail. The parcel is saved before anything is given, so a crash can neither lose nor double it.
      Parameters:
      from - the sending plugin's name, shown with a parcel ("Quests")
      titleKey - the parcel's title, a translation key of the sending plugin, or null for "A parcel"
      params - the title's parameters, or null
      Returns:
      false only when nothing could be given or kept: no items, or the player is offline with a full mailbox
